what_it_is.prose: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), the Miniratna Category-I Defence PSU under the Ministry of Defence headquartered in Hyderabad, has stated intent to develop a counter-drone system as part of its future roadmap. In an October 2024 interview with Indian Aerospace and Defence Bulletin (IADB), BDL CMD Commodore A Madhavarao (Retd) stated: 'Working on the development of... Drone-delivered missiles and Bombs, Weaponization of High endurance UAVs, High Energy Weapon System, Counter Drone System, Loitering Munition, Combat Autonomous Vehicles (Ground and Water)...'. The same interview noted BDL is 'particularly' focused on hard-kill solutions for anti-drone systems. However, as of the BDL products page update on 24 August 2026, no counter-drone system is listed among BDL's product portfolio, which includes TAL, Varunastra, MRSAM, Dishani, QRSAM, MIGM, VL-SRSAM, FLAME, KLTE, Akash Weapon System, KMTE, ASW Suite, Astra Weapon System, CMDS, SAAW, C-303, Helina (Dhruvastra), C 303S, Amogha-III ATGM, NAG ATGM, INVAR, Konkurs-M, Milan-2T, and ATGM Unified Launcher. This dossier is therefore classified as Tier C — the evidence bar for a full dossier has not been met and the page is marked noindex until a BDL counter-drone product is formally launched.
